name: Blueflame
knownUsers: Dabi / 荼毘 — later identity details omitted
continuity: Main-series power; medium and continuity are recorded separately.
firstDemonstration: No verified TV season/episode is published for this entry yet.
firstNamedExplanation: Japanese label verified on the official profile; first TV explanation not verified.
lore: Dabi produces blue flames. This entry omits his later identity and forms.
adaptation: All moves, numerical values, challenges and resources are mod adaptations. Grounded footwork and physical jabs are complementary training. This is an experimental development kit.
resource: Heat rises with output and recovers gradually. Controlled Cooling removes 35 heat during its active stance.
drawback: Heat above tolerance prevents another flame cast; underwater fire is refused. Cooling gives no immunity.
counters: Break line of sight and punish startup/recovery.
Avoid predictable guard windows; reposition beyond effective range.
nonCombatUtility: Timed rescue positioning and supervised field objectives.
equipment: The Cadet suit is equipment and grants no quirk. Ordinary jabs and grounded footwork are explicitly complementary training.
acquisition: Operator-enabled experimental pools and permission-checked creative tokens only. Earn mastery and field milestones per quirk; no automatic maximum mastery.
verification: Japanese label, associated user and blue-flame principle verified from the official character profile on 28 October 2026. English move labels are adaptations.
